name: LOSERTOWN
source:
Gabe is ready for love, he's known this for a while,
... but for the longest time, he's been afraid of getting to know people and making the first move; To make the most of his twenties, he's giving himself less than a week to get to know one of his friends better, which will hopefully result in them saying yes to going out with him! "it's a crazy idea, but it might just work!"

[From [url=https://sandglas.itch.io/losertown]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
加布已经准备好迎接爱情了，他已经知道这一点有一段时间了，
……但很长一段时间以来，他一直害怕结识别人并迈出第一步；为了充分利用自己的二十几岁，他给了自己不到一周的时间来更好地了解他的一位朋友，这有望让他们同意和他出去！“这是一个疯狂的想法，但它可能会起作用！”

[来自[url=https://sandglas.itch.io/losertown]Itch.io[/url]]
